$schema_comment: Wave 0 pins for Farhad Flow CI desktop builds. Bump deliberately; Wave 2–3 scripts must honor these.

tauri.notes: Stable Tauri 2 line as of pin date; CLI 2.11.3 is latest published tauri-cli matching 2.11.x.

rust.notes: Align with current tauri-cli rust-version (>=1.90). Use rustup toolchain 1.90.0 for CI.

node.notes: Build-time only (FE bake). Matches Langflow Vite 8 floor (Node 20.19+ / 22.12+). End users do not need Node.

python.notes: Prefer install_only_stripped for size. Wave 2 freezes venv on top of this interpreter.

linux.notes: Wave 3: vendor-git.sh builds from this tarball into resources/git/ (bin + libexec) with NO_RUST=YesPlease (no cargo). Prefer same major.minor as MinGit for staff parity.

release_artifacts.notes: Control Package=farhad-flow-ci. Tauri raw deb uses productName (spaces); build-ubuntu.sh copies to farhad-flow-ci_X.Y.Z_amd64.deb + staff alias. Depends = WebKitGTK/GTK only (no python/git).
